errorCodes.meaning: The website is in live mode, which has no generations. Managed mode only.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

current.description: True for the generation current resolves to.

deployedAt.description: When this generation was deployed. A rollback target is chosen by *when* far more often than by number.

sizeBytes.description: Total size of the generation on disk. Distinguishes a real deployment from a truncated or empty one before an operator rolls onto it.

Response.title: VTC Website Generations List — response payload
